content_sections.heading: SLBSNSU Library Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SLBSNSU Library Professional Trainee Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Library Professional Trainee post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Library Professional Trainee post at SLBSNSU is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Library Professional Trainee position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor of Library and Information Science (BLIS) or Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS) with first division from a recognized university. Knowledge of MS Office, LMS, and IT applications in libraries is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Library Professional Trainee role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Library Professional Trainee position is 30 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the current information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Library Professional Trainee post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Library Professional Trainee post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Library Professional Trainee position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Library Professional Trainee post at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Library Professional Trainee recruitment involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the SLBSNSU office. The exact address is New Delhi, Delhi - 110016.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Library Professional Trainee position is on a contract basis.
